description: Motor shaft passes through one sleeve carrying both journals; D-flat bore takes torque
assembly_note: Default. Phase fixed by machining; sleeve captured axially by rear and front plates; no set screw

description: As above with a round bore and a forward collar for radial set screws
assembly_note: Collar passes through the front plate and output hub bore; motor shaft must be eccentric_collar_length longer
Legacy. Phase fixed by the flats; no set screw possible because the bearings cover the sleeves

description: Stepped coupled shaft with female motor socket plus the sleeve options above on its concentric core
assembly_note: Simpler lathe work than the integrated shaft

description: One-piece coupled shaft carries two integral eccentric journals 180 degrees apart
assembly_note: Rear bearing/disc installs from the coupling end; front bearing/disc from the front
